sections.heading: Why Observe
sections.body: We cannot tune vibes we cannot see. Observability is not just logs and metrics; it is purposeful instrumentation of beats and loops. We capture timing and state changes that relate to human experience.

sections.heading: Meaningful Metrics
sections.body: We track acknowledgement latency, time-to-first-meaningful-paint, and undo usage. We avoid vanity graphs and focus on indicators that correlate with perceived quality and trust.

sections.heading: Tracing User Journeys
sections.body: We attach a journey ID to flows so we can analyze where momentum stalls. Visualizing these traces reveals branching points that need clarity or defaults.

sections.heading: Privacy-aware Telemetry
sections.body: We collect just enough. We aggregate where possible and anonymize or hash sensitive identifiers. Telemetry is documented and opt-out paths are respected.

sections.heading: Exercises
sections.body: Instrument one loop end-to-end. Create a small dashboard with timing percentiles and undo rates. Use the results to adjust budgets and copy.
